$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0. The one NATS subject tree of OneMind OS (issue #600, contract sdk/contracts/poc-v0.md section 12.9). Read by the gateway (core/onemind_core/subjects.py, GET /v1/subjects), the lint (sdk/tools/subject-lint, run by make lint) and Go (sdk/schema/embed.go). A new kind, pattern or placeholder is a contract change: add it here first, with a test.

publishers.gateway: the gateway on the hub: the only writer of core subjects; it validates, stamps source and licence, and re-publishes
publishers.node: a joined machine's onemindd, through its own NODE_<id> account: only subjects carrying its own node id
publishers.app: an installed app, plugin or bridge, through its own APP_<id> account or the gateway relay: only subjects carrying its own app id
publishers.agent: an AI agent, through the AGENTS account import: only requests carrying its own agent id, which the server stamps; a request never acts until a person approves

token.description: one lowercase subject token: a name chosen by OneMind (source, field, domain, layer), never a record id

id.description: an opaque record id of contract 12.1 as it is, case kept: a prefixed ULID (job_01HX..., usr_01HX..., alrt_01HX...), a UUID v4 or an asset id; never lowercased or re-encoded, and an id holding a dot cannot ride the tree

agent_name.description: an agent principal id agent:<name> without the agent: prefix, one subject token per dot-separated part: agent:hermes.v2 is hermes.v2 (two tokens); a name with an empty part (two dots in a row, or a trailing dot) has no subject and is refused

type.description: a dotted event type such as backup.run.finished

path.description: an app's own relative subject, as in spec.streams

asset_class.description: an open asset class such as camera, sensor, device or machine; robot has its own reserved channels

robot_channel.description: the reserved robot channels (no robot work until OneMind has a robot; names only)

onemind.datapoint/v1.description: one observed value: value, unit, time, quality, source, licence, sequence, optional WGS-84 position or framed pose

onemind.event/v1.description: the event envelope of contract section 12.8

onemind.message.event/v1.description: the onemind.event/v1 envelope of the two message events: ids and metadata only, never the text (#855)

onemind.node.event/v1.description: a durable node event, re-published by the gateway as onemind.event.<type>

onemind.job/v1.description: a signed job for the backup agent on the gateway's own box (loopback HTTP only, never on the bus)

onemind.job/v2.description: a signed job for one node: v1 plus aud (node:<node_id>), kid and policy_epoch, all signed (D-029)

onemind.policy/v1.description: a machine's signed stop and revoke snapshot: epoch, stop switches, revoked job keys, allowed kinds; only ever adds a no (D-029)

node.description: facts a machine reports about itself, and the jobs the gateway sends it

audit.description: the hash-chained audit log, as published by the gateway

event.description: validated domain events (action, node, app, backup, alert, notification ...)

alert.description: alert records; nodes raise theirs through the outbox and the gateway re-publishes

asset.description: the normalised state of one thing (camera, sensor, device, machine, vehicle ...); the map pin, video tile and dashboard card are views of it

intel.description: normalised observations from intelligence and news bridges, each with its source and licence

metric.description: numeric samples (cpu, temperature, rates); history lives in the series store, not in JetStream

plugin.description: an app's, plugin's or bridge's own subjects (events and raw intake under in.>); durable only through the app's own spec.streams

layer.description: map layer metadata and deltas; owner is core or the app id, as the map namespaces plug:<app>:<id>

notification.description: a person's inbox changed: ids only, never the text; the inbox itself stays in the gateway database

request.description: an agent or app asks for something; the gateway turns it into an approval card and only a person approves

reserved_kinds.app: retired prefix of the first spec.streams slice (PR #540): an app's subjects live under onemind.plugin.<app_id>.
reserved_kinds.cmd: commands never travel on the bus: an agent or app sends onemind.request.* and a person approves
reserved_kinds.device: a device is an asset: onemind.asset.device.<asset_id>.<field>
reserved_kinds.lora: a radio is driven only by Ed25519-signed jobs from the gateway to onemindd on its loopback job API (#855); nothing on the bus makes a radio transmit
reserved_kinds.message: message text never rides the bus: the gateway publishes ids only on onemind.event.message.received and onemind.event.message.status (#855)
reserved_kinds.radio: a radio is driven only by signed jobs (see lora); its status is served by GET /v1/radios, not published (#855)
reserved_kinds.robot: a robot is an asset with reserved channels: onemind.asset.robot.<asset_id>.<channel>

mappings.to: unchanged: kinds node, audit, event and alert
mappings.note: every subject in code today stays valid
the app may also publish there itself, through its own account, under its own id only
onemind.app is a reserved, refused kind
the manifest keeps the relative evt.app name; the gateway relays it onto the tree
projection bridge, not a rename of the cluster
the asset service is the only writer
series history in the series store
a bridge writes only its own intake; the gateway normalises
CoT is built only by the TAK bridge; inbound CoT never creates an action

mappings.to: none: onemind.request.<agent|app>.<id>.<type> plus a person's approval

mappings.note: drop the agent: prefix; each dot-separated part of the name is one token and request_type is always exactly one last token, so the split is unambiguous; the agent's NATS permission is publish onemind.request.agent.<name>.* only; a name with an empty part has no subject

mappings.from: job_01HX..., usr_01HX..., asset ids, action UUIDs
mappings.to: the id slot as it is (jobresult.<job_id>, notification.person.<person_id>, asset.<class>.<asset_id>)
mappings.note: ids keep their case and are never re-encoded; job kinds keep their dots (job.backup.run, job.system.restart_unit)

mappings.to: unchanged, outside onemind.> in the AGENTS account
mappings.note: talking on agents.* gives no power
